intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The Palace Court hosts a wedding for two people separately accused, with evidence, of talking too much.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’m told the guests expect a speech from the bride. As if they could stop one.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Not the one with three key points?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “New one. It’s called *In Case of Awkwardness, Break Glass.*”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: When the guests settle, Tavri steps forward. Her tail gives one nervous swish.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I had jokes ready. They were excellent. One of them had a goat in it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She looks at the guests, then at you, and puts her notes away.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’m happy to be here, with the person I chose.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: That’s the whole speech. She sits down looking extremely pleased with herself.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Later, in the gardens, a gossip scroll flutters down. It claims the newlyweds plan to have fifty children.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Let’s start smaller. One houseplant. See if it survives us.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Leave it with me. I’ll draw up a maintenance schedule.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I said yes to you without one. Look how well that’s going.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You buy a fern. It survives. The maintenance schedule does not.
